 # Guilin & Yangshuo Travel Guide
 > Independent, honest travel guide for Guilin and Yangshuo. Itineraries, costs, visa advice, and local tips — no tour sales, no fluff.
 
 ## Core Guides
 - [Yangshuo Travel Guide](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/yangshuo-travel-guide/): Complete Yangshuo guide — attractions, transport, food, where to stay.
 - [Guilin Travel Guide](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/guilin-travel-guide/): Guilin city sights, best areas, how to use Guilin as your base.
 - [3-Day Itinerary](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/guilin-yangshuo-itinerary-3-day/): The classic Guilin to Yangshuo 3-day plan.

 - [5-Day Deep Dive](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/guilin-yangshuo-itinerary-5-day/): Add Longji Terraces and Xingping.
 
 ## Activities
 - [Li River Cruise](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/li-river-cruise/): The classic 4-hour cruise through karst scenery.
 - [Yulong River Bamboo Rafting](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/yulong-river-bamboo-raft/): Quieter alternative on a tributary.
 - [Moon Hill](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/moon-hill/): 800 steps to a natural arch with panoramic views.
 - [Ten Mile Gallery](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/ten-mile-gallery/): The best bike ride in China.
 - [Yangshuo Cycling Routes](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/yangshuo-cycling-routes/): Three self-guided bike routes.
 - [Xingping Ancient Town](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/xingping-ancient-town/): The 20 RMB banknote village.
 - [Longji Rice Terraces](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/longji-rice-terraces/): 650-year-old terraced mountains.
 - [Yangshuo Rock Climbing](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/yangshuo-rock-climbing/): World-class limestone sport climbing.
 - [Best Photo Spots](https://guilin-yangshuo.com/guilin-yangshuo-photo-spots/): 12 locations with GPS and shooting times.
